coursework.en: The retained student record supports effective, ethical, critical and transparent AI use generally. That support does not establish permission for a particular assessment; old scenario rules remain excluded.
coursework.zh: 保留的学生条款一般支持有效、合乎伦理、审慎且透明地使用AI，但不证明具体考核获准；旧情景规则继续排除。

exams.en: No retained current-conclusion Claim establishes a Glasgow exam-use rule here. The old Regulation32 and three-scenario statements are historical/pending, not substitutes for the assessment brief.
exams.zh: 本页当前结论所保留的条款未确定Glasgow考试AI使用规则。旧Regulation32与三情景表述仅作历史或待审资料，不能替代考核说明。

disclosure.en: The student record says unacknowledged AI or computational help in university work counts as misconduct. Acknowledgement is necessary context, not blanket permission to use AI.
disclosure.zh: 学生记录称，在大学作业中未说明AI或计算辅助的贡献属于不当行为。披露是必要条件语境，不是普遍AI使用许可。

privacy_data.en: IT guidance says confidential or sensitive university or third-party information should not enter AI tools. The PGR checklist separately cautions against research data and peer-review material.
privacy_data.zh: IT指引称不应向AI工具输入学校或第三方的保密、敏感信息；PGR清单另提醒避免上传研究数据与同行评审材料。

approved_tools.en: The IT record identifies Copilot Chat for university data when using UofG credentials. This is a scoped data-security record; individual eligibility and assessment use remain separate.
approved_tools.zh: IT记录指明使用UofG账户时Copilot Chat可用于学校数据。这是限域数据安全记录，个人资格与考核使用仍须分别核对。

research_publication.en: Research guidance records critical oversight and relevant ethics/data-protection processes. The PGR checklist has a separate audience; full current-source verification remains incomplete.
research_publication.zh: 研究指引记录了审慎监督及相关伦理、数据保护程序。PGR清单适用对象另有范围，完整现行来源核验仍未完成。

academic_integrity.en: The retained acknowledgement rule addresses undisclosed assistance. It does not itself establish investigative steps, penalties or appeal deadlines, and old Regulation32 conclusions remain excluded.
academic_integrity.zh: 保留的披露规则针对未说明的辅助，不据此确定调查步骤、处罚或申诉期限；旧Regulation32结论继续排除。

teaching_guidance.en: Assessment-design guidance encourages demonstrating skills beyond recall and says AI use is not always plagiarism. It does not remove assessment-specific restrictions or approve a new scenario policy.
teaching_guidance.zh: 考核设计指引鼓励展示超越记忆的能力，并称AI使用不必一概视作抄袭；这不取消具体考核限制，也不批准新的情景政策。

security_procurement.en: Copilot university-data approval depends on the university-account context and security conditions. It is not approval for every data category, service mode or examination.
security_procurement.zh: Copilot的学校数据批准依赖学校账户及安全条件，不是对所有数据类别、服务模式或考试的批准。

basis.evidenceSnippet: Microsoft Copilot Chat is a Generative AI tool that uses the same large language models as Open AI's ChatGPT, but with added security. It is the only AI service approved for use with University data.

There is therefore one overriding principle, which applies to all staff, students, and researchers at the University: any use of generative AI tools must be accompanied by critical analysis and oversight on the part of the user.
It is important to note that using any form of AI or other computational aids in your university coursework, study, exams, or research without acknowledging that input counts as academic misconduct.
Confidential or sensitive information (including, for example, IP) belonging to the University or any third party should not be put into AI tools.

Where AI tools form part of your research design or methods, the tool kit within your discipline, or are a subject of your research, your use of them as a researcher should be covered by relevant ethical approval and data protection processes.
Consequently, rather than seek to prohibit your use of these tools, we want to support you in learning how to use them effectively, ethically, critically, and transparently.
Avoid uploading confidential or sensitive information to an AI tool (this includes research data and peer review content).

It is important to recognise that the use of GenAI in assessment should not, in all cases, be treated as plagiarism. Rather we should carefully consider how we design assessment to ensure that students can demonstrate skills beyond purely knowledge recall.

teaching_guidance.en: Assessment-design guidance encourages demonstrating skills beyond recall and says AI use is not always plagiarism. It does not remove assessment-specific restrictions or approve a new scenario policy.
teaching_guidance.zh: 考核设计指引鼓励展示超越记忆的能力，并称AI使用不必一概视作抄袭；这不取消具体考核限制，也不批准新的情景政策。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: General student support, IT guidance and PGR/research advice have different scopes. Old Regulation32 and three-scenario records are excluded; new2026–27 proposals are pending, so no current exam permission is inferred.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 一般学生支持、IT指引与PGR/研究建议适用范围不同。旧Regulation32和三情景记录已排除，新2026–27提案待审，不据此推导当前考试许可。

security_procurement.en: Copilot university-data approval depends on the university-account context and security conditions. It is not approval for every data category, service mode or examination.
security_procurement.zh: Copilot的学校数据批准依赖学校账户及安全条件，不是对所有数据类别、服务模式或考试的批准。
security_procurement.meaningEn: General student support, IT guidance and PGR/research advice have different scopes. Old Regulation32 and three-scenario records are excluded; new2026–27 proposals are pending, so no current exam permission is inferred.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 一般学生支持、IT指引与PGR/研究建议适用范围不同。旧Regulation32和三情景记录已排除，新2026–27提案待审，不据此推导当前考试许可。
